fields.options: 1) Enable Offline Sync. 2) Add DocTypes to sync. 3) Open /offline (use http://127.0.0.1 or HTTPS so the Service Worker installs). Advanced app packs (Fitzgerald field UI, etc.) are optional below.

fields.description: Primary setup for any app: pick DocTypes to browse, create, and edit in the /offline PWA (IndexedDB). Saving with rows here auto-enables the Generic DocTypes pack.
fields.label: DocTypes

fields.description: Optional packs registered by installed apps (e.g. Fitzgerald My Tasks / Label Scan on /offline_app). Not required for generic DocType offline.
